details:
It makes you unable to download content if you have even the slightest weird thing in your network
see, i am using my PC's wifi antenna to make  a hotspot to use ALVR to connect my quest wirelessly to PC, because my regular router is cooked
the PC is still connected to the internet via ethernet, trough the most default average router out there.
But i cannot download content off the servers.
No worlds, no avatars, no thumbnails.
And i got rate limited so hard for some reason, that when i went to oculus link instead to eradicate the weirdness, the download speed got reduced to something so low that it took 5 minutes to load a single 4mb avatar.
Can still connect to worlds fine, i mean i danced in pypydance, it's just that everyone was a robot.
This is not the only time something like this happened. Sometimes i have to try 3 times to load into a world. Also, sometimes the avatar favourites just stop working randomly.
like holy crap chill out the network protection system thingy. Nobody will open ports on their router just to play funny ugandan VR game, because a random update happened to the servers.
title: What the hell is up with the network protection system in VRChat?
